description: COVID-19 Estimated Inpatient Beds Occupied by State Timeseries is published by U.S. Department of Health & Human Services. The historical estimates describe occupied inpatient beds across states with uncertainty bounds. Its stated coverage is United States; state time series discontinued in July 2021. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License. The provider stopped updates after improved reporting made these estimates obsolete. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
